description: HP-20 is the official registration code for the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) in Una, Himachal Pradesh. Operating under the jurisdiction of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), it manages the issuance of driving licenses and vehicle registration for the Una sub-division. It is one of several codes serving the Una district to ensure decentralized and efficient transport administration.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Una, District Una, Himachal Pradesh
